data.body: Implementation complete in the isolated worktree based on origin/main 7cf80009d9. RED evidence: the new class-chain and Sonnet-native contracts initially failed in four places because rebar.toml had no fallbacks and direct Sonnet remained prompted. GREEN evidence: frontier and standard now resolve Bedrock primary -> matching direct-Anthropic fallback, trivial remains single-arm, and direct/Bedrock Sonnet both carry equivalent native schemas without prompted directives. Verification: focused fallback/config/parity set 58 passed; make lint passed; make typecheck passed; full non-integration/non-external suite under pytest-xdist 11,822 passed, 49 skipped, 0 failed in 424.32s. Review found and documented one deliberate tradeoff: mixed Bedrock/Anthropic chains disable prompt caching because provider-specific cache styles conservatively intersect to none.
